title: Coconut Krok Pies
description: Delicate coconut-filled krok pies that melt in your mouth. Inspired by the sweet treats of Thailand.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine coconut cream, heavenly rice flour, fluffy sugar, and Thai red beans.
Add khanom filling and mix until well combined.
Roll out krok pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out small squares of pastry and place a spoonful of the coconut mixture in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together with a fork.
Brush the tops of the pies with a little village milk and sprinkle with coconut flakes.
Place the pies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Drizzle with a little vanilla essence and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Note: The khanom filling is a key component of this recipe, so make sure to use high-quality filling for the best results.
